CustomField.description: Ascending sort order for display purposes. The DonorGiftSummary formula fields FQS_Donor_Level__c and FQS_Donor_Level_Name__c evaluate donor groupings by comparing Minimum Amount values directly — Sort Order does not affect formula evaluation order.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Controls the display order of donor groupings in Setup and reports. Lower numbers appear first. This field is for presentation only — the FQS_Donor_Level__c formula evaluates donor groupings by comparing Minimum Amount values from highest to lowest, not by Sort Order.
CustomField.label: Sort Order
